Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert encountered a "403 Forbidden" error while attempting to scrape the Wikipedia page and then suggested a manual inspection of the citation reference link without actually verifying or ensuring the retrieval of the correct first citation reference link. This incomplete and unverified assumption led to a fabricated URL (`http://example.com/carl-nebel-reference`) being used, which is not the actual citation link from the Wikipedia page. This error directly impacted the ability to solve the problem correctly, as the task required analyzing the image on the actual webpage linked in the first citation reference, not the assumed or fabricated one.
